title: Study PX-101 Pharma Research #1
text: Oncology Clinic Network ran Study PX-101. Study PX-101 interviewed Dr. Rivera about treatment decisions. Dr. Rivera mentioned TheraX and Dr. Rivera compared TheraX with Standard of Care in later lines of the transcript.

title: Study PX-101 Pharma Research #2
text: Patient Persona A reported Fatigue after several treatment cycles. Patient Persona A experienced Injection Anxiety before clinic visits, and Injection Anxiety reduced Adherence in the journey map.

title: Study PX-101 Pharma Research #3
text: Caregiver Segment B supported Patient Persona A with appointment scheduling. The Patient Support Program improved Adherence by sending reminders and coordinating refill support.
